title: Manyhands JSON v1 polling policy mutation data
description: The data of a poll configure, poll pause or poll resume envelope, on success and on a no-op: the registration's polling policy as the request's transaction left it. A replay gives it as it was then; poll status reads what is stored now.

backoff_seconds.description: The stored doubling state. A poll resume leaves it.

recovery_suspended.description: Automatic polls stay blocked while this is true. A poll resume does not lift it.

next_eligible_at.description: The stored deadline. Null when none is stored, so an eligible poll is due.
